task_description: Implement the complete OnCall AI Agent Control Plane API - a Node.js Express REST API with 28 endpoints across 7 route groups (Agent Lifecycle, Incident Management, Runbook Execution, Escalation Policies, Knowledge Base, Communications, Metrics & Observability). Includes Bearer token auth, in-memory state, realistic mock responses, tests, and documentation.

verification.summary: All 56 tests pass. Server starts cleanly on port 3000. Tests cover auth middleware, all 7 route groups, query filtering, error cases, and validation logic. Tests exercise real API behavior and would fail if code were reverted.
